items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: "Come on, Chef. Did I send you all, girl?"

ctx.x: They just play ratatoude. Funky butt, funky butt, take it away. I heard that head wouldn't. Come on, Chef. Did I send you all, girl?
Tunes that they played. Uh-huh. What were some of the other tunes like that they played by head?
